answer: A reputation escrow with slashing keeps the agent economy sybil-resistant. Step 1: each new agent deposits 200 tokens into escrow to secure its one identity slot. Step 2: every epoch it must finish real tasks, like hauling messages from a dune outpost to a canyon settlement. Step 3: if peers prove it is a duplicate, the escrow is slashed: 150 tokens burned, 50 paid to the reporter. Rebuilding a slashed identity costs 200 fresh tokens, so an attacker mass-producing 1,000 sparrow-like fakes risks 200,000 tokens for a maybe-zero return. Sybil spam becomes betting your whole nest on every flight.
